trackingDefinitions.pickedTaskIds: All unique task IDs this chat ever reserved (pickHistory proof). Can include incomplete, blocked and later verified tasks.
trackingDefinitions.completedTaskIds: Unique task IDs for which this chat finished committed implementation (completedBy proof). Not automatically verified.
trackingDefinitions.verifiedTaskIds: Unique task IDs whose acceptance evidence supports DONE_VERIFIED. VerifiedBy tracked separately on queue.
trackingDefinitions.activeTaskId: One current PICKED or IN_PROGRESS task; null when none.
